Most people assume that changing who they are is a project measured in years. Years of therapy, or a level of discipline they have already failed to sustain more than once. The brain does not work that way. It is not a fixed object handed to you at birth. It is a structure that quietly rebuilds itself around whatever you repeat, which means identity is far less something you discover and far more something you assemble.

Repetition on its own is slow. The subconscious is not argued into a new belief by logic, it updates through repetition that carries emotion with it. Repeat something while your body genuinely feels it and the brain begins filing it as normal.

That is what these six habits are built on.

Visualize your future self for 10 minutes before sleep, because imagination fires the same neural pathways as real life. Track the moments you shrink, self sabotage or hesitate to want what you want, and write them down, because those moments are your programming showing its hand. Rewrite one limiting belief daily and repeat it until your body agrees. Feel gratitude instead of listing it, because it was never the words that rewire you, it is the emotion. Create micro proof of the identity you are building, since small actions are affirmations your nervous system cannot argue with. And regulate your nervous system daily, because a brain stuck in stress has no capacity to rebuild anything.

None of the six overlap. One gives the brain a target, one exposes the old programming, one changes the language, one supplies the emotion, one supplies the evidence, and one keeps the system open enough to change. Run one and you nudge a habit. Run all six and you rebuild an identity.

The trap is waiting to feel ready. Motivation is a mood, and it arrives after the repetition, not before it. Six weeks will pass whether you use them or not, and the person you are at the end of them is already being shaped by what you repeat today.

Start with one. Stack the next when the first one holds.

Today, I want to honour the incredible Louise Hay, a true pioneer in the self-help industry and a beacon of self-love and healing. 🌼

↓ How to change your self-image ↓ 

Comment ''Self-Esteem'' to get my free self-esteem guide ❤️

When you change your self-image, you change your life. 

My clients have gone from socially anxious, to feeling calm & confident by doing this exact practice & today I am giving it away for free.

So SAVE it for later ❤️

1. Get clear on what negative beliefs you currently carry about yourself. 

Help questions: What am I afraid other think of me? What parts of yourself do you dislike, and why? What am I afraid will happen when I am myself? 

2. Realise that your mind always tries to proof the things it already beliefs. So you don't see a reflection of reality, you see a reflection of your self-image in your outside world. 

3. Reframe the negative beliefs into positive ones.

4. Look for evidence of these new beliefs every day. You self-image (and subconscious mind) can only be rewired through repetition.

5. Stop the narrative of the negative self-image, when it comes up.

Science proved THIS changes reality ⬇️
ㅤ
In the Double Slit Experiment, particles don’t behave like solid matter until they’re observed. Before observation, they exist as probabilities. The act of observing collapses those probabilities into a single outcome. This isn’t philosophy - it’s measured PHYSICS.
ㅤ
Your brain works the same way. Your subconscious attention acts as the observer, constantly collapsing one version of reality out of many possible ones. When your focus is trained on threat, lack, or resistance, that’s the timeline that keeps rendering.
ㅤ
The Delayed Choice Experiment went even further, showing that observation can influence outcomes backward in time. Which explains why, when your internal state shifts, past events suddenly make sense differently and opportunities appear where nothing existed before.
ㅤ
You’re not manifesting incorrectly. You’re observing consistently. Change the observer, and the reality being rendered has no choice but to change with it.

Crispy cheesy hashbrowns

Ingredients 

8-9 medium russet potatoes 
5 tbsp corn starch
4 oz shredded cheddar cheese 
Salt to taste
1 tsp black pepper 
1 1/2 tsp garlic powder 
Oil for frying 

For the sauce 

1/2 cup mayonnaise 
2 tbsp ketchup 
1 tbsp hot sauce 
Salt to taste
1 tsp garlic powder 
1/2 tsp black pepper 
1/4 tsp smoked paprika powder 
1 tsp lemon juice 

Method 
Peel the potatoes Add to a pot of salted water and boil for about 8 minutes, just until they are partially cooked. They should still be firm in the center. Drain the potatoes very well and let them cool until they’re easy to handle. Grate them using the large holes of a box grater. Spread the grated potatoes out for a few minutes to allow excess steam to escape. If they feel particularly wet, gently squeeze out any excess moisture.
Add the grated potatoes, cornstarch, cheddar cheese, garlic powder, black pepper, salt. Gently mix until everything is evenly combined.

Take a portion of the mixture and firmly press it into a thick rectangle or oval. Repeat with the remaining mixture.
Heat about 1 inch of oil in a skillet over medium heat to 360°F. 
Carefully add the hash browns and fry for about 3–4 minutes per side, or until deeply golden and crispy.
Transfer to a wire rack or paper towel-lined plate and let the excess oil drain.
For the sauce 
Mix mayonnaise, ketchup, hot sauce, garlic powder, black pepper, salt, and lemon juice (or pickle juice) until smooth and creamy.
Serve the hash browns hot and crispy with the dipping sauce.

Follow @neurosciencetalk for the neuroscience of who you become.

Most of us assume that changing who we are takes years of therapy or discipline we have already lost once. Your brain does not work like that. It is not a fixed object you were handed at birth. It keeps rebuilding itself around whatever you do over and over, which means your identity is less something you find and more something you build.

Repetition alone is slow, though. Your subconscious does not change its mind because of facts or logic. It updates when the repetition carries real feeling with it. Repeat it while your body truly feels it, and your brain treats it as normal.

That is what these 6 habits are built on.

Spend 10 minutes before sleep picturing your future self, because imagination fires the same pathways as real life. Write down the moments you shrink or hold yourself back, because those moments show you the old programming at work. Turn one belief that keeps you small into one that lifts you, and repeat it until your body agrees. Feel your gratitude instead of just listing it, because the feeling is what rewires you, not the words. Give your brain small proof of who you are becoming, since small actions are evidence your nervous system cannot argue with. And calm your nervous system every day, because a brain stuck in stress has no room left to rebuild anything.

Each habit does a different job. One gives the brain a target, one exposes the old programming, one changes the words, one brings the emotion, one brings the evidence, and one keeps the system open to change. Use one and you nudge a habit. Use all 6 and you rebuild who you are.

The trap is waiting to feel ready. Motivation is a mood, and it shows up after the repetition, not before it. The next six weeks will pass either way, and who you are at the end of them is being shaped by what you repeat today.

Pick one habit tonight, and stack the next one once it holds.

You might be asking why one should put 90% focus on self-concept, let me explain it with an example. One of my clients asked me why her SP is showing cold behaviour and ignoring her ? So by working on self-concept, we are removing all those limiting beliefs and building a strong base to let our manifestations stay in our lives after we have successfully manifested them.
Step2: SP affirmations (10% Focus - Focusing on the desired version of SP)
Ask yourself what is the desired version of your SP, what he/she is doing for you. How does he/she make you feel? How you guys are spending time together? What are the things you guys are doing together?

Как сделать карту желаний?💫

Никаких воронок и перегонов тут не будет ахаха, вся информация тут🤍 
В видео рассказываю об основных правила, читай текст, чтобы правильно подписывать свои картинки на карте💫

✨Первое правило - формулировать желания в настоящем времени.
Пиши так, будто желаемое уже является частью твоей жизни. Это позволяет мозгу воспринимать цель как нечто реальное, а не далёкую мечту «когда-нибудь». Настоящее время задаёт правильную вибрацию и формирует ощущение, что желаемое уже осуществляется.
Например: «я отдыхаю в самом красивом отеле», «я покупаю свой новый дом»

✨Второе правило - под каждой картинкой обязательно прописывать истинный смысл своего желания.
Фотографии создают настроение и визуальный ориентир, но именно слова являются важным пунктом при составлении карты желаний! Картинки могут быть красивыми, вдохновляющими, но если не уточнить, что именно ты вкладываешь в это, желание может исполниться не в той форме, которую ты ожидаешь. Все пойдет не по плану, хоть желание может и исполниться в конечном итоге.
Когда ты прописываешь смысл, ты отвечаешь себе на вопрос: «Что я на самом деле хочу получить, прожить в этой ситуации?». Те не просто «переехать», а более детально.

✨Третье правило - описывать своё состояние в момент исполнения желания.
Ведь мы стремимся не просто к каким-то материальным объектам, а к внутренним ощущениям, которые они дают.
Добавляй формулировки о своем состоянии, на момент получения желаемого. «Я переезжаю в свою новую прекрасную квартиру, это благоприятно на меня сказывается и я счастлива»

Помните, пожалуйста, что карта желаний-не волшебная палочка и мы прикладываем много сил для достижения поставленных целей💫

Two years ago my life completely changed and it didn’t happen because of one big moment.
It was the small, consistent habits that shifted everything.

Here are the 6 that actually moved the needle ↓ 

Also, comment the word “manifest” and I’ll dm you a link to all the products I used 🫶🏼 

1. Make a vision board you actually see every day.
Skip the magazines make a collage for your phone lock screen.
You look at your phone 100+ times a day, and this repeated exposure trains your brain’s Reticular Activating System to notice opportunities that match your goals.

2. Manifestation, but with extreme detail.
Your brain doesn’t differentiate between imagination and reality.
The more vividly you picture your future life, the more your subconscious aligns your habits and confidence to match it.

3. Move your body daily.
A person in motion stays in motion.
Movement boosts energy, discipline, executive function, and stress resilience which is why nearly every high-performing person prioritizes their health.

4. Win tomorrow tonight.
Plan your next day the night before.
Preparation removes resistance, reduces decision fatigue, and helps you stick to your goals even when life gets busy.

5. The “do it now” rule.
The text, the laundry, making the bed don’t wait.
Micro actions build identity.
You stop being someone who delays… and become someone who gets things done.

6. Adopt an abundance mindset.
You will never win operating from scarcity.
Successful people want others to win because abundance keeps you creative, open, and collaborative while scarcity keeps you stuck.

And if no one has told you yet:
✨ You’ve got this.
✨ You deserve the life you keep imagining.
✨ Small habits compound into big realities

There’s a reason some goals stay “ideas,” and others turn into tangible outcomes.

What research has shown again and again is that manifestation isn’t about wishing more. It’s about clarity, structure, and follow-through.

Writing your goals down. Turning vague wishes into specific intentions. Adding timelines, checkpoints, and small wins. Planning for obstacles instead of hoping they won’t appear.

These steps don’t just organize your plans; they train your brain and body to move in the same direction.

1. Write down your intentions
Get specific. Vague desires create vague results, so name exactly what you want with clarity and detail. Writing it down moves it from a passing thought into something real, something your mind can start organizing around.

2. Elevated emotions create a new energy
This is the part most people skip. It’s not enough to just want something; you have to feel it. Gratitude, joy, excitement, these are the emotional signatures that shift your internal state and, according to Dispenza’s work, actually begin to change your biology and the energy you’re putting out into the world.

3. Live in it before it arrives
Act, think, and carry yourself as the version of you who already has what you’re calling in. This is where Neville Goddard’s teaching comes in: living from the end, occupying the feeling of the wish fulfilled rather than waiting for proof before you allow yourself to feel it.

10 Laws Of Attraction That Will Change Your Life 🧠

1. Law of Vibration — Everything is energy. Your thoughts and feelings send out a “vibe.” Positive vibes attract positive things. Negative vibes attract struggles. Keep your energy high.

2. Law of Belief — What you believe deep inside becomes your truth. If you believe you can succeed, you will. If you believe you’re not good enough, you’ll block success. Believe in yourself first.

3. Law of Clarity — Be clear about what you want. The universe can’t deliver if you’re confused. Say exactly what you want—don’t just wish for “a better life,” say what that means to you.

4. Law of Gratitude — Being thankful brings more to be thankful for. When you appreciate what you already have, the universe gives you more.

5. Law of Alignment — Be who you want to attract. Want love? Be loving. Want success? Be focused and hardworking. You attract what you are.

6. Law of Environment — Your surroundings affect your energy. Keep your space (and your thoughts) clean, calm, and inspiring.

7. Law of Identity — Want better things? Be a better version of yourself. Act, think, and feel like the person who already has what you want.

8. Law of Action — The universe loves movement. Don’t just wait—do something, even if it’s small. That first step invites results.

9. Law of Magnetism — You attract what you are. Your energy pulls in matching energy.

You will never outperform your self-image. 🧠

We think self-image is a reflection of reality. It is not. Self-image is a prediction model — and the brain works to make it true. When you believe you are not enough, the brain filters evidence to confirm it. It ignores contradictions. It amplifies failures. It builds a case.

This is not pessimism. It is neuroscience. The Default Mode Network runs your self-narrative on repeat — and every repetition strengthens the neural pathway. The voice in your head is not telling you the truth. It is telling you the story it has rehearsed most often.

You cannot think your way to a new identity. You have to act your way into it. New behavior creates new evidence. New evidence updates the model. The question is not „Who am I?“ — it is „What am I rehearsing?“ Because what you rehearse, you become.

You are not your self-image. You are the awareness that can observe it.

Do you need a new goal every day? No. Your daily decisions need to serve one end goal.

Setting a new goal every morning isn't the answer. Your goal isn't a daily task. It's your destination, and its job is to guide the decisions you make today.

Every morning, ask one question: does this decision move me closer to my end goal?

If yes, do it. If no, let it go.

That's the real role of a goal. It helps you decide what to say yes to, what to say no to, and where to put your energy, so your days add up to what you want at the end.

5 things you need to stop taking personally if you want to change your life:

1. PEOPLE NOT UNDERSTANDING YOU.
You don’t need everyone to understand your decisions, your ambitions or the direction you’re taking. Stop explaining your vision to people who were never meant to see it.

2. BEING REJECTED.
Not being chosen doesn’t mean you’re not worthy. Sometimes something simply isn’t meant for you. Don’t let one person’s inability to see your value make you question it yourself.

3. OUTGROWING PEOPLE.
You’re allowed to change. You’re allowed to develop new standards, interests and priorities. You don’t owe anyone an older version of yourself just because that’s who they know.

4. NOT BEING WHERE YOU THOUGHT YOU’D BE.
Your life isn’t running late. Comparing your current chapter to someone else’s highlight reel will only make you overlook how far you’ve already come.

5. MAKING MISTAKES.
One bad decision doesn’t make you a failure. One setback doesn’t erase your progress. Stop turning temporary moments into permanent beliefs about who you are.
The way you interpret what happens to you shapes the way you see yourself. And the way you see yourself influences the life you allow yourself to create.

Stop taking everything as a reflection of your worth. Sometimes it’s just life happening.

Have you ever stopped to think about how you speak to yourself when nobody else is listening?

The little comments about your body.
The way you criticize your reflection.
The things you say when you make a mistake.
The way you sometimes become your own harshest critic.

I know what that feels like because I used to be that woman.

I used to look in the mirror and focus on everything I wanted to change. I was so hard on myself, sometimes without even realizing it.

But something beautiful happened along my journey.

I started changing the way I spoke to myself.

I started appreciating my body instead of constantly criticizing it. I started recognizing my beauty instead of searching for imperfections.

And this morning, as I looked at myself in the mirror, I felt so much love and appreciation for the woman looking back at me.

Not because everything about me is perfect.

But because I finally understand that I don’t have to be perfect to love myself.

And here’s what I want you to remember today.

Detach and persist in your new story No matter what the 3D is showing you, no matter how convincing the 3D looks, and no matter how impossible the 3D looks, we need to learn to detach from the 3D. Focusing too much on the 3D circumstances can keep our attention on the same old story and the same unfavourable loop. So detach from the 3D and put your focus on already having your desire by using any manifestation technique of your preference. Sometimes our mind asks, “How is it going to manifest?” especially when we are experiencing the complete opposite. Every time your mind asks you that question, simply remind yourself, “I do not need to figure out the HOW. It is already taken care of by the Universe,” and continue persisting with your new story. Your mind may naturally try to bring your focus back to the old story, but each time, gently redirect your attention back to the new story. You do not need to analyse the 3D, investigate your SP’s behaviour, assign negative meanings to what you see, or look for validation in the 3D. Give yourself permission to DETACH. Your job is to decide what is true for you and continue occupying that new story. So whenever the 3D feels discouraging, take a breath, let it be, and return your focus to what you have decided is true. Stay persistent and soon the 3D will mirror your new story.

✨ What if the life you desire started feeling familiar instead of feeling so far away?

One important part of manifestation is learning to become comfortable with the reality you’re working towards.

If you desire success, start getting comfortable with being seen, taking responsibility and making confident decisions.

If you desire financial abundance, work on developing healthier money habits and feeling comfortable handling bigger opportunities.

If you desire a healthy relationship, practise receiving love, expressing your needs and maintaining healthy boundaries.

The idea is to stop treating your desired reality as something completely unfamiliar.

Visualise it, understand the habits it requires, and gradually introduce those behaviours into your everyday life. 🤍

Don’t just dream about a different life. Start becoming familiar with the experiences and choices that support it.

How to have BALANCE in 2023 🌱⬇️

It’s a new year! Maybe you’re rushing to set big goals, adding items to your bucket list and vision board… but there’s something you might have missed out 🔍

It’s the reason why we fall off track, get burnt out or give up in the middle of the year… 😔

Here’s the ONE thing you need for balance ❗️🕊️

✨ 𝗔 𝗵𝗲𝗮𝗹𝘁𝗵𝘆 𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗱𝘀𝗲𝘁 𝘁𝗼𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗴𝗼𝗮𝗹𝘀.

A healthy mindset means
☁️ You recognize your goals may take longer than expected
☁️ You’re willing to work towards them even though setbacks or failures happen
☁️ You’re committed to showing up even though it’s not “perfect”
☁️ You know that progress is progress, no matter how small

With this mindset you recognize that self-care is essential to long-term progress 🧘‍♀️💖 

➡️ You set aside time to recharge each day.
➡️ You practise self-compassion and don’t sacrifice your health while working.
➡️ You make time for meaningful relationships, enjoyable activities & rest in your schedule.

Going into 2023, I hope you will remember that your rest & health is so important. That you will take time to make self-care a priority for yourself! 

Please SAVE & SHARE if this resonated with you 💌
